title: 2 Kings Bible Quiz - Chapter 7
description: Ten questions on 2 Kings 7: Elisha's word about food in the gate, the four lepers and the empty camp of the Syrians.

questions.text: According to Elisha, what would a seah of fine flour be sold for the next day in the gate of Samaria?
questions.explanation: Elisha said that tomorrow about this time a seah of fine flour would be sold for a shekel in the gate of Samaria.

answers.text: Ten shekels
Eighty pieces of silver
A talent of silver
A shekel

questions.text: What did Elisha tell the captain on whose hand the king leaned?
questions.explanation: When the captain doubted, Elisha said, 'Behold, you will see it with your eyes, but will not eat of it.'

answers.text: You will be the first to buy bread in the gate
You will see it with your eyes, but will not eat of it
You will lead the army against the Syrians
You will be taken captive to Damascus

questions.text: Who was sitting at the entrance of the gate?
questions.explanation: There were four leprous men at the entrance of the gate, who asked one another why they should sit there until they died.

answers.text: Two watchmen of the city
Seven elders of Israel
Four leprous men
The sons of the prophets

questions.text: What did the lepers decide to do?
questions.explanation: The lepers said, 'Let's surrender to the army of the Syrians. If they save us alive, we will live; and if they kill us, we will only die.'

answers.text: Surrender to the army of the Syrians
Climb over the wall into the city
Flee across the Jordan
Hide in the hills until the siege ended

questions.text: Whom did the Syrians think the king of Israel had hired against them?
questions.explanation: The Syrians heard the noise of a great army and said the king of Israel had hired the kings of the Hittites and the kings of the Egyptians to attack them.

answers.text: The kings of Moab and of Edom
The king of Judah and his mighty men
The princes of Tyre and of Sidon
The kings of the Hittites and of the Egyptians

questions.text: What did the lepers do in the first tent they entered?
questions.explanation: The lepers went into one tent, ate and drank, carried away silver, gold and clothing, and went and hid it.

answers.text: Burned it so the Syrians could not return
Ate and drank, and hid the silver, gold and clothing
Waited there until the morning light
Called out to the gatekeepers from it

questions.text: Why did the lepers decide to go and tell the king's household?
questions.explanation: They said, 'We aren't doing right. Today is a day of good news, and we keep silent.'

answers.text: It was a day of good news and they were keeping silent
The Syrians were coming back to their camp
They had been seen by a watchman on the wall
Elisha had sent a messenger to call them

questions.text: What did the king think when he heard the Syrian camp was empty?
questions.explanation: The king said the Syrians had gone out of the camp to hide in the field, planning to take them alive when they came out of the city.

answers.text: The Syrians had gone back to Damascus
Yahweh had struck the Syrians dead
The Syrians were hiding in the field to take them alive
The lepers were lying to the gatekeepers

questions.text: What did the messengers find along the path all the way to the Jordan?
questions.explanation: The path to the Jordan was full of garments and equipment which the Syrians had cast away in their haste.

answers.text: Garments and equipment the Syrians had cast away
The bodies of Syrian soldiers who had fallen
A Syrian army camped by the river bank
Food and water left for their return

questions.text: What happened to the captain whom the king put in charge of the gate?
questions.explanation: The people trampled over the captain in the gate, and he died as the man of God had said.

answers.text: He was made ruler over the city
The people trampled over him and he died
He fled with the Syrians to the Jordan
He bought the first seah of flour
